note: Wyoming State Parks archaeological site NE of Hyattville in the Medicine Lodge Creek canyon, with petroglyph cliffs and an interpretive cabin. Its three small campgrounds are strung about 800 m along the park road among cottonwoods; a creek beach is used for fishing and wading. --Claude
